title: Implementation Opinions on the Standardised Application and Innovative Development of AI Agents
title_original: 智能体规范应用与创新发展实施意见
summary: Policy opinions issued jointly by the Cyberspace Administration of China, the National Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, reported on 8 May 2026. They implement the State Council's 'AI+' opinions for AI agents. Their principles are safety and controllability, orderly standards, innovation and application-led development. Measures cover technical foundations and agent standards and protocols; product rules, security risk prevention, a governance system and industry self-regulation; 19 typical application scenarios across research, industry, consumption, livelihoods and social governance; and building an agent ecosystem.

sources.title: 三部门部署智能体规范应用与创新发展
